title: Peacock dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

    <circle cx='92' cy='42' r='2' fill='#1a3a8a'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='4' fill='#f5d020'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#1a3a8a'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='8' fill='#2f7bf0'/>

  <line x1='50' y1='25' x2='46' y2='18' stroke='#3fd9a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='54' cy='17' r='2' fill='#f5d020'/>
